raw_text: BREAKING Colombo: Tear gas fired at protesters near Fort Railway Station. Thousands demanding rollback of IMF-imposed tax hikes. Water cannons deployed on Lotus Road. Reports of journalists being detained. Sri Lanka economic crisis deepening as fuel queues return across Western Province.
